versions.content: The API shall report a runtime error ADC_E_TRANSITION_NOT _ POSSIBLE in case the requested power state cannot be directly reached from the current power state. All asynchronous operation , needed to reach the target power state , can be executed in background in the context of Adc_Main_PowerTransitionManager.
